summary: Stage 2.8 voice-first STT + Brian/Jenny name swap verified. New /api/clarity/stt endpoint validates anonymous (401), missing field (400/422), empty audio (400), unsupported MIME (400), and oversize >24MB (413) — all paths fail BEFORE Whisper SDK is invoked, so zero LLM credits spent. Public preview URL returns the exact spec'd 401 detail 'Sign in to continue.' for both /api/clarity/stt and /api/clarity/tts (TTS unchanged). Booking confirmation guide_label swap verified end-to-end via TestClient: guide_name='clarity' → guide_label='Brian'; guide_name='grace' → guide_label='Jenny'; internal slugs unchanged. Regression: test_phase1_identity.py 4/4 and test_phase1a_presence_signals.py 12/12 still pass in isolation. Frontend code-inspection confirmed HolographicCalendar GUIDES array now uses Brian/Jenny labels with internal slugs clarity/grace, GuidePresence eyebrow labels say Brian/Jenny, useVoiceIO exports the documented surface (supportedIn/Out, transcribing, MediaRecorder→/api/clarity/stt path), BodyRoomChat exposes both data-testid='body-room-chat-mic' and 'body-room-chat-mute'. Frontend webpack still compiling cleanly after my one minor fix.
critical_code_review_comments: GuidePresence.jsx had a stale 'Clarity'/'Grace' string in the (lines 92-98) — would have leaked the old human-facing names to screen-reader users + image-search bots. FIXED by this agent (1 line each: alt now says 'Guide portrait — Brian' / '— Jenny'). Recommend a one-line lint guard or unit snapshot against /Clarity|Grace/ in user-visible JSX strings to catch future drift, since the internal slugs intentionally still read 'clarity'/'grace' in code paths.

Pre-existing: pytest's TestClient + FastAPI lifespan does not tear down the asyncio event loop between modules, so a multi-module run produces 'RuntimeError: Event loop is closed' on the second module's setUp. Not introduced by Stage 2.8 — already documented in iter 62 brief — but worth fixing once with a session-scoped TestClient or a `pytest-asyncio` mode='session' upgrade so future regression suites can run as a single command.

/api/clarity/stt: when `audio_field` arrives without an explicit content_type (some browsers omit it for blob fallbacks), the empty `base_ct` skips MIME validation entirely and falls through to size+empty checks. Acceptable today (Whisper will reject garbage) but consider a fail-closed default once telemetry shows real-world content_type coverage.
